items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Duchin made an arrangement on it, made a recording on it.

ctx.x: Oh, what was that? I know Louis made a record in '35 in New York named Old Man Mose, and there was something --
It was from the piano sheet. See, he made a record, and also, Eddie Duchin made an arrangement on it, made a recording on it.
I remember, when I was a kid, seeing a movie short of -- first time I had ever seen Betty Hutton. She was still with Vincent Lopez' band.
